اصطخبوا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَخَبُوا (iṣṭaḵabū) /isˤ.tˤa.xa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# اُصْطُخِبُوا (uṣṭuḵibū) /usˤ.tˤu.xi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# اِصْطَخِبُوا (iṣṭaḵibū) /isˤ.tˤa.xi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
